description.value: Rooftop Coffee Roasters is a family-owned roastery-café founded in 2016 by Keegan Street, who began roasting coffee at age 16 on the rooftop of his family home in Fernie. The current café sits in historic downtown Fernie under that same rooftop, offering specialty single-origin and blended coffees sourced through direct relationships with producers. The shop also sells whole beans, instant coffee, and a coffee subscription club.
